description: Per-chat watermarks plus per-topic turn references for the chat topic bucketer. One subject is one topic even when its turns span several chats.

last_active.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the newest turn in this topic.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences: what this thread is about and where it stands.

title.description: Short human-readable title, 6 words or fewer.

assistant_excerpt.description: Assistant's reply, quoted or closely paraphrased, 300 chars or fewer.

chat_id.description: UUID of the chat this turn came from.

chat_name.description: Human-readable chat name at index time.

seq.description: Highest message seq within the turn.

user_excerpt.description: User's message, quoted or closely paraphrased, 200 chars or fewer.

additionalProperties.description: Highest message seq processed so far for this chat; the watcher only classifies newer turns.

watermarks.description: Map of chat UUID -> last processed message seq. New chats get seeded from their 10 most recent turns.

title: Chat topic index
